image_description: A close-up shot of a slice of pale yellow cake (possibly cheesecake or sponge) on a white plate. The cake is topped with thick, dark brown chocolate sauce drizzled in ribbons down the side. There is also a pool of chocolate sauce on the plate to the left, next to a red strawberry and a small chocolate garnish. A decorative arch of chocolate sits on top of the cake.

Specular highlights are clearly visible on the curves of the drizzles and the pool on the plate.
The context of cake, strawberry, and plating confirms its role as a dessert condiment.
